bbab52e96b570354.description: مدير مكتب الرئيس التنفيذي | Executive Office Manager الموقع: الرياض – المملكة العربية السعودية نوع العمل: دوام كامل – حضوري المستوى الوظيفي: اداري تنفيذي الوصف الوظيفي والتوجيهات الصادرة من الرئيس التنفيذي حتى اكتمال تنفيذها * التنسيق المباشر مع مدراء الادارات والشركات التابعة ومتابعة الاعمال المشتركة * اعداد التقارير اليومية والاسبوعية عن سير الاعمال والمهام والانجازات والتاخيرات * التحضير للاجتماعات واعداد جداول الاعمال ومحاضر الاجتماعات ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات * ادارة المراسلات والاتصالات الرسمية والتنسيق مع الجهات الداخلية والخارجية * ترتيب اولويات العمل وتنبيه الرئيس التنفيذي للموضوعات العاجلة والقرارات المطلوبة * الاشراف على السكرتارية التنفيذية وتنظيم الملفات والوثائق والمعلومات * المحافظة على السرية التامة للمعلومات والقرارات والاعمال الخاصة بالرئيس التنفيذي * تطوير اليات العمل داخل المكتب التنفيذي ورفع مستوى الكفاءة وسرعة الانجاز المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة * خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 5 سنوات في ادارة المكاتب التنفيذية او العمل المباشر مع القيادات العليا * خبرة سابقة في العمل مع رؤساء تنفيذيين او ملاك شركات او مجموعات اعمال * مهارات عالية في التنظيم والتخطيط وادارة الوقت والاولويات * شخصية قوية ومهنية تتمتع باللباقة والحزم وحسن التصرف * قدرة ممتازة على المتابعة المستمرة وتحقيق النتائج دون الحاجة الى توجيه متكرر * اجادة اللغة العربية والانجليزية تحدثا وكتابة * اجادة استخدام Microsoft 365 وOutlook وExcel وادوات ادارة المهام * القدرة على التعامل مع ضغوط العمل وتعدد المسؤوليات وسرعة تغير الاولويات * مستوى عال من الانضباط والسرية والموثوقية والاهتمام بالتفاصيل الصفات الشخصية التي نبحث عنها نبحث عن شخص مبادر وسريع البديهة ومنظم ودقيق يمتلك حس المسؤولية والقدرة على توقع الاحتياجات قبل طلبها شخص يتابع المهام من تلقاء نفسه ويحرص على اغلاقها في مواعيدها ويقدم الحلول بدلا من الاكتفاء بنقل المشكلات هذا المنصب مناسب لمن يمتلك عقلية ادارية تنفيذية ويجيد تحمل المسؤولية والعمل باستقلالية وليس لمن يقتصر دوره على انتظار التعليمات وتنفيذ المهام الروتينية

bbf33764dfe4540d.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Head Chef / Head Pastry Chef) Compensation: 7,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven pastry professional to bring quiet excellence and creativity to their pastry section. The Role As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will support the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. You will take ownership of daily production—ranging from delicate viennoiserie to refined plated desserts—while maintaining uncompromising quality, developing the junior team, and confidently stepping up to lead the section when needed. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated pastry experience, with at least 2 to 3 years serving as a Chef de Partie Pastry or senior pastry cook within a fine dining or upscale restaurant setting. Technical Foundation: Deep, hands-on knowledge of viennoiserie, doughs, creams, chocolate work, and fillings, alongside a strict understanding of shelf life, storage protocols, and allergen controls. Traits: Precise, creative, and quietly excellent. You are cost-aware and focused on consistency. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional skills in French or another European language are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Pastry Techniques: Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision, care, and a highly refined eye for presentation. Leadership & Mentoring: Actively participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintain discipline during busy services, and lead the section with confidence in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Production & Storage: Plan daily production, rigorously monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and flawlessly execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Hygiene & Quality: Ensure every item leaving the section meets strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal while keeping the workspace clean, safe, and fully compliant. Cost & Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste, ensuring premium quality is maintained without losing sight of food costs.

bb121ad51e06faad.description: About Geidea Established in 2008, Geidea provides digital payment solutions through continuous innovation. The company focuses on attracting talent to develop solutions that support businesses of varying sizes and maturities. Geidea is currently seeking a Data Engineer Sr. Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Purpose The Data Engineer Sr. Manager leads the development, operation, and continuous improvement of Geidea's enterprise data platform on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This full-time role involves overseeing the delivery of reliable, secure, and scalable data engineering solutions that support business intelligence, payments and operational reporting, regulatory requirements, and advanced analytics initiatives. The manager provides technical direction, manages engineering delivery and team performance, and ensures data platform capabilities align with business priorities, enterprise architecture, and applicable regulatory requirements. Key Accountabilities and Decision Ownership Develop and manage the data engineering roadmap in alignment with the organization’s data strategy and business priorities, ensuring initiatives support evolving business needs and enterprise architecture standards. Oversee the design, development, and operation of the enterprise data platform on GCP, maintaining reliability, availability, performance, and scalability of data services and pipelines, and resolving incidents and technical issues. Lead the development and integration of batch and real-time data pipelines across various systems and sources, ensuring data is processed reliably and made available for business and analytical requirements. Provide technical direction across the GCP data environment, including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Datastream, Dataplex, and Data Catalog. Establish engineering standards and guide solution design and code reviews. Oversee the development of well-modeled, reusable data products that support business intelligence, management and regulatory reporting, risk and fraud analysis, and AI/ML initiatives, including integration with Vertex AI. Lead and develop the data engineering team by setting objectives, managing workloads and resources, reviewing performance, and providing technical guidance and coaching. Establish data quality and governance practices covering automated validation, data contracts, lineage, ownership, classification, retention, and access requirements, in collaboration with Data Governance and business stakeholders. Ensure the data platform incorporates appropriate security and privacy controls, including identity and access management, network restrictions, encryption, and data masking, in coordination with Information Security, Compliance, and Risk to support requirements such as SAMA, PDPL, NDMO, and PCI DSS. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in data engineering and management roles. Geidea Values Geidea's operations are guided by core values: Customer first: Embedded in design thinking and customer service. Open: Fosters continuous improvement and evolution. Real: Emphasizes directness and accountability. Bold: Encourages challenging existing approaches and thinking. Resilient: Focuses on learning and recovering from setbacks. Collaborative: Promotes teamwork for achieving shared goals.

This full-time position is based in Riyadh and reports directly to the Executive Manager of IT Change Management. The role focuses on ensuring the integrity and accuracy of configuration management processes within the organization. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain the SAMA ITG Framework System Configuration Management domain to a maturity level of 3. Review and record configuration items for Requests for Change (RFCs). Manage the lifecycles of Infrastructure Discovery and Application/Service Mapping. Monitor and report on Configuration Management related Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs). Govern the configuration management process and maintain all related documentation, including policies, procedures, and templates. Produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly progress reports and dashboards. Ensure that Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tasks related to every change request are properly closed and reviewed. bb440b287bca89fa.description: Job description Company Description Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF). Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene. Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector. Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. Designed to amplify Middle Eastern creativity on the global stage, LIONS Riyadh will showcase the region’s talent, ideas and storytelling while connecting its creative industries with the world’s leading networks, brands and decision-makers. The inaugural three-day Festival takes place at KAFD, Riyadh, from 6–8 December 2027. It will bring together regional and global CMOs, creative leaders, agencies, brands and emerging talent around creative excellence, effectiveness, culture and the future of the industry. Job Description This role is responsible for overseeing the individual assigned territories and being a contributor to ensure the achievement and exceeding of sales revenue targets for the team in accordance with the sales plan. The Sales Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing and converting commercial opportunities across brands, agencies, media companies, technology platforms and the wider creative economy. This role will provide a high level of prospecting, relationship building and account management to existing and prospective exhibitors to sell solutions which meet with the client's needs. The successful candidate will take a consultative sales approach, understanding each client's objectives and matching them with relevant opportunities across the Festival, including exhibition presence, brand experiences, sponsorship and bespoke commercial solutions. The role requires strong commercial drive, curiosity and a good understanding of the creative, advertising, marketing and media sectors. Key Focus Achievement of sales revenue targets, campaign management, floor plan management within timelines Achievement of KPI’s as set out by the Portfolio – phone time, face to face meetings, systems. Exhibitor satisfaction levels including regular follow ups via emails and calls, onsite rebooking’s and retention. Timely & accurate reporting of sales results, pipeline and activities. Development of new business across priority brands, agencies, media, technology and creative-industry clients. Growth of existing accounts through deeper relationships and relevant commercial opportunities. Strong understanding and communication of the LIONS proposition, audience and Festival experience. Contribution to a high-quality commercial mix that strengthens the overall Festival. Key Responsibilities Sales and account management - identify, pitch and secure relevant brands, agencies, media companies, technology platforms, production businesses and creative organisations to participate in the Festival. Drive Sales performance in the relevant product assignments, ensuring individual achievement of set revenue targets in accordance with the sales plan. Understand each client’s objectives and support them to achieve these through the event campaign. Utilize resources to tailor sales approach to build new relationships and enhance existing relationships. Maintain regular contact with existing clients throughout the event cycle. On-site account management to achieve high exhibitor satisfaction levels and retention. Builds strong relationships with multiple client/customer stakeholders. Identify new prospects through use of industry media, social media, online resources, industry networking and company CRM. Develop new business and revenue streams, including sponsorship and other non-square-metre opportunities. Work with the wider Commercial, Marketing and Creative teams to develop solutions tailored to client objectives. Present and sell commercial opportunities through strong storytelling and value-led pitches rather than inventory alone. Develop a good understanding of the creative, advertising, media and marketing landscape in Saudi Arabia and internationally. Ensure accurate capture of all sales activities, opportunities and pipeline information in CRM. Completion of sales progress reporting (e.g. revenue vs target, activity reporting etc.). Monitor the debt reports and assist the finance team with revenue collection. Continually monitor and research the market using online resources, gaining customer feedback, attending competitor events where appropriate, and industry networking. Ensure up to date market intelligence is available for the Head of Sales and Marketing Manager to assist with different campaigns. Stay informed on industry trends, major agencies, brands, media platforms and emerging creative businesses that may be relevant to LIONS Riyadh. Support onsite account management and ensure clients receive the commercial experience promised during the sales process. Qualifications Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Sales Manager. Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience. Relevant commercial experience may be considered in place of formal qualifications. Essential: Significant & successful experience in a sales roles. Commercial Awareness. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills. Strong communicator and confident presenter. Numerate with strong attention detail. Proven ability to prospect, build pipeline, negotiate and close new business. Ability to understand client needs and translate them into relevant commercial solutions. Good understanding of media, advertising, marketing or the creative industries. Confidence engaging with senior client stakeholders and decision-makers. Strong CRM discipline and ability to manage an active sales pipeline. Collaborative approach and ability to work closely with Marketing, Content, Creative and Operations teams. Desirable: Experience in media sales, advertising, sponsorship, partnerships, creative-industry sales or major events. Existing relationships across brands, agencies, media or technology companies. Awareness of exhibition production. Saudi Arabia or GCC market experience. Experience selling bespoke or solutions-led commercial products. Strong interest in creativity, culture, media and emerging industry trends. Additional Information Core Benefits: Medical Insurance for individual and family Annual leave – 25 days Remote working on Sundays Working anywhere – 1 month every year School fees contribution, 40,000 SAR per child per year (up to a max of three children) Wellbeing Benefits Residency visa including yearly dep

Solid integration and cloud architecture skills, including REST APIs, Adobe I/O / App Builder, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Ability to communicate architecture clearly to both senior business stakeholders and technical teams. Comfort working independently in a contract capacity and quickly integrating into established client teams. Preferred Qualifications Adobe certifications such as Adobe Certified Master or Expert (AEM Architect, AEP Architect). Experience in regulated or public-sector environments (*, financial services, government, telecoms). Experience with Adobe Commerce or Workfront.

bbdebdd98567b4bc.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Yard Operative to join their team in Dammam. This full-time position is ideal for individuals with 0-1 years of experience who are committed to maintaining safety and operational efficiency within a yard environment. The role involves critical tasks related to scrap material handling and site maintenance. Key Responsibilities Signal and guide incoming scrap trucks to designated unloading locations to ensure safe scrap discharge. Assist inspectors in verifying truck volume using measuring tape. Segregate oversized, unwanted, non-metallic, explosive items, and closed containers (gas/hydraulic cylinders) from incoming scrap supplies, moving them to designated areas before the shift ends. Manually clean leftover scrap from truck bottoms after unloading, as required. Support the cleaning of basket loading areas and the Scrap Transfer Car (STC) track from the loading point to the charging bay. Assist in cleaning spilled scrap from the Scrap Transfer Car. Aid in cleaning entrapped scrap and impurities beneath the STC weighing scale using compressed air. Clean and wash scrap handling equipment during shutdown periods. bb24f1256adae1a6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ أنشطة الشراء اليومية لضمان توفير المواد وقطع الغيار والمعدات والمستهلكات والخدمات في الوقت المناسب، وذلك وفقاً للسياسات والصلاحيات المعتمدة في الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية معالجة طلبات الشراء المعتمدة بكفاءة ودقة. طلب عروض الأسعار من الموردين ومقارنة الجوانب المختلفة مثل السعر والمواصفات والجودة وشروط التسليم والسداد. إعداد أوامر الشراء واستكمال جميع الموافقات اللازمة قبل إصدارها. متابعة الموردين وجداول التسليم والمتطلبات المعلقة لضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد. التنسيق الفعال مع أقسام الإنتاج والصيانة والعمليات والمستودع والمالية لضمان سلاسة العمليات. معالجة أي تأخير أو نقص أو فروقات في الأسعار أو مشكلات تتعلق بالتوريد. البحث عن موردين جدد وبدائل مناسبة عند الحاجة لضمان أفضل الخيارات المتاحة. حفظ وتوثيق جميع الطلبات والعروض والأوامر ومستندات التسليم والمراسلات بشكل منظم. التحقق من فواتير الموردين ومستنداتها بالتنسيق مع القسم المالي. إعداد تقارير المشتريات والتوريدات المعلقة وتصعيد المشكلات عند الضرورة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المشتريات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مقارنة العروض وتقييم الموردين. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والتنسيق مع الأقسام الداخلية والموردين الخارجيين. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات في سياق عمليات التوريد. تفاصيل العمل نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة.

bb2fa76a3e2c4beb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان تنفيذ خطط الصيانة الدورية والطارئة للمباني المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى متابعة الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، وتحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات لفرق العمل، ومتابعة دوامهم، بالإضافة إلى رفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات جيدة في التنسيق والمتابعة وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومقره في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب العمل التنسيق المستمر مع المهندسين وفرق العمل المختلفة لضمان سير عمليات الصيانة بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

bb31945338d13c1b.description: About the Role SAB is seeking a Medium Enterprises Team Leader to join the Small and Medium Enterprises Department. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and focuses on managing and expanding client relationships within the medium enterprises segment. Key Responsibilities Maintain and enhance relationships with key customer accounts and prospective customers to ensure business continuity and growth. Prepare a structured calling program to identify business opportunities and explore customer needs, matching them with the bank's products. Monitor and expand share of wallet and cross-sell opportunities from all clients. Drive diversified revenue improvement for the assigned portfolio. Monitor the performance of all accounts assigned to relationship managers on an ongoing basis. Monitor the business operating environment, including market trends, interest rates, asset and liabilities positions, trade volume, and credit facilities. Provide regular updates to the regional head on account performance and key market thrusts. Plan and coordinate marketing of products and services to clients within the portfolio to maximize revenue and return. Ensure the quality of the credit portfolio by reviewing proposals and assessing inherent risks in credit exposures. Analyze client financial statements and management practices to assess credit risk and maintain portfolio credit quality. Recommend, reject, or approve credit facilities within prescribed limits after comprehensive analysis. Structure financial transactions to meet the requirements of corporate clients. Collaborate with internal departments such as Wholesale and Market Risk, Legal, and Operations for smooth and quick transaction processing. Ensure the provision of high-quality and timely service to clients. Work Environment This role is a full-time position within the Small and Medium Enterprises Department at SAB, located in Jeddah, Makkah.

bb357323d35e37b4.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Senior Electrical Estimation & Design Engineer with over 10 years of experience. This full-time role involves comprehensive electrical estimation, design, and project bidding, focusing on the preparation of Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and ensuring compliance with international standards. Role Overview The successful candidate will be responsible for interpreting electrical drawings, performing accurate quantity take-offs, and developing detailed electrical designs. This position requires strong coordination skills with vendors and bidding teams to achieve competitive project costs and ensure successful tender submissions. Key Responsibilities Review and analyze project drawings, specifications, and requirements to determine project scope, materials, and equipment needs. Perform quantity take-offs and determine material and resource requirements for electrical projects. Prepare Bills of Quantities (BOQs) from MEP electrical drawings and Single Line Diagrams (SLDs). Prepare and review electrical design calculations, drawings, specifications, and Bills of Materials (BOMs). Develop Protection Single Line Diagrams and ensure all designs comply with applicable international codes and standards. Conduct electrical estimation and BOQ preparation for both industrial and residential facilities. Coordinate with the bidding team for project estimation and tender submissions. Liaise with vendors, negotiate pricing, and commercial terms to achieve competitive project costs. Carry out transformer sizing, DG sizing, load calculations, cable sizing, cable schedules, circuit breaker sizing, and protection system sizing. Prepare electrical layouts and Single Line Diagrams using AutoCAD. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical estimation, design, BOQ preparation, and project bidding. Demonstrated expertise in interpreting electrical drawings and specifications. Proficiency in developing electrical designs and performing relevant calculations. Experience with AutoCAD for preparing electrical layouts and Single Line Diagrams. Strong understanding of international electrical codes and standards. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

bb35d81d7d75bd38.job_title: Senior Consultant/ Manager Cyber Operate Governance & PMO Specialist
bb35d81d7d75bd38.description: About Deloitte Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms globally, recognized for its impact on clients, people, and society. The firm has received multiple awards, including Best Employer in the Middle East and Best Consulting Firm. Deloitte operates with shared values to deliver innovative insights and solve complex challenges for clients, while fostering an inclusive culture for its professionals. The Role: Senior Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Application Security Specialist Deloitte is seeking a Senior Consultant Manager, Cyber Operate Application Security Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves developing and demonstrating capabilities in application security, focusing on secure development standards, embedding security in CI/CD pipelines, conducting in-depth application assessments, and driving vulnerability remediation. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Define secure SDLC, secure coding standards, and application security requirements, aligning with NCA ECC, OWASP ASVS, and NIST SSDF. Establish security requirements and acceptance criteria for in-house and vendor-built applications, including contract clauses and release checks. Build and maintain an application inventory with risk ratings for each application. Implement and tune SAST, DAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Checkmarx, Fortify, Veracode, SonarQube, Snyk, and Burp Suite. Triage tool findings, remove noise, and provide clear, actionable guidance to developers to maintain release velocity. Review container, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud-native deployments with DevOps teams. Conduct application security assessments of web, mobile, and API applications, including manual testing of authentication, authorization, and business logic. Perform secure code reviews for high-risk features and components. Lead threat modeling for new applications and major changes, collaborating with architects and development teams. Review third-party and SaaS applications prior to adoption. Track application vulnerabilities to closure with development teams and vendors, verifying fixes before release. Report application risk posture and trends to management. Train developers on secure coding, OWASP Top 10, and API Security Top 10, and establish a network of security champions within development teams. Leadership Capabilities Understand Deloitte's purpose and values, exploring opportunities for impact. Demonstrate commitment to personal learning and development, acting as a brand ambassador. Understand expectations and maintain personal accountability for performance. Actively develop effective communication and relationship-building skills. Understand how daily work contributes to team and business priorities. Experience and Work Type This role requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. It is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Candidates interested in this role are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

bb472489e17719db.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أسترا الإنشاءات عن مدير خدمات لوجستية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية التخطيط لأنشطة تخزين البضائع وتوزيعها وتوجيهها وتنسيقها، مع ضمان تسليم المنتجات بفعالية من حيث التكلفة ودون تأخير. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع استراتيجيات الشركة وسياساتها وخططها العامة المتعلقة بالخدمات اللوجستية، ومباشرة تنفيذها. إدارة أنشطة الخدمات اللوجستية والتوزيع اليومية وتوجيهها، ومباشرة تخزين البضائع وتوزيعها. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة مستوى أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. مراقبة أداء العمليات والموظفين مقارنة بالأهداف المحددة، وتحديد الأنماط، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة، وتنسيق أنشطة تصليح المعدات بما يضمن تقليل زمن التعطل عن العمل. وضع السياسات والإجراءات لضمان الالتزام بقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها، ومباشرة تنفيذها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الخدمات اللوجستية أو إدارة سلسلة التوريد. فهم عميق لمبادئ التخزين والتوزيع وإدارة المخزون. القدرة على وضع الاستراتيجيات والسياسات اللوجستية وتنفيذها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قيادية وإدارية قوية للإشراف على الفرق وتوجيهها. القدرة على تحليل الأداء وتحديد مجالات التحسين واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط والتنظيم وحل المشكلات. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، بنظام عمل دوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أسترا الإنشاءات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

bb6839ebc6453e5e.description: Monitor operational parameters of the system locally and coordinate with the CCR Operator for all activities affecting plant operations. Responsible for safe startup and shutdown of the plant in line with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Roles & Responsibilities Comply with safety rules and regulations; be familiar with firefighting equipment in the assigned area. Follow instructions from the Shift Supervisor / Shift Charge Engineer and CCR Operator. Be familiar with plant P&IDs, SOPs, work instructions, basic control logics, emergency operating procedures, and related documents. Monitor operational parameters and record periodic readings in log sheets. Record and summarize all shift activities and events in the logbook. Inspect plant areas and auxiliaries to ensure equipment parameters remain within limits. Report any abnormalities immediately to the CCR Operator. Perform equipment changeovers according to preset schedules. Raise work requests or defect notes for malfunctioning or faulty equipment. Coordinate with CCR Operator / Shift Supervisor for isolation and line up of equipment and systems before and after maintenance. Maintain good housekeeping standards and ensure cleanup after maintenance activities. Follow all standard operating procedures and work instructions at all times. Assist in training and familiarization of new operators. Report near misses and implement prescribed risk control measures. Report deviations related to Quality, Health, Safety, and Environmental Management Systems. Ensure proper waste identification, handling, and disposal. Perform any other duties as assigned by supervision. Job Specifications General awareness of Quality, Occupational Health & Safety, and Environmental Management System principles Knowledge of waste identification, classification, and disposal Knowledge of emission monitoring Knowledge of environmental and health impacts of chemicals used in the plant Knowledge of firefighting equipment Knowledge of PPE and safety equipment Knowledge of first aid measures Good understanding of power and water plant operational activities Communication skills Desired Certification / Job Specific Skills / Training ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001 awareness or working knowledge (preferred) Desired Candidate Profile Education Desired: Diploma Preferred: Degree Minimum Experience (Type and Duration) Minimum: 4 years experience in Power or Desalination Plant operations Preferred: Experience in the Middle East

bb8031a731f3b90a.description: About the Role: Inventory Specialist Taasco International Trading LLC is seeking an Inventory Specialist to manage and control inventory for its conveyor belt manufacturing and trading operations in Jeddah. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, offering a salary of ﷼1,800–﷼2,200 per month. Key Responsibilities Manage raw materials, finished conveyor belts, spare parts, accessories, and trading products. Accurately and promptly record receipts, production consumption, issues, transfers, returns, and dispatches. Verify physical stock against ERP or system records, reconcile differences, and investigate discrepancies. Monitor minimum and reorder levels, coordinating with Purchase and Production to prevent shortages. Identify and report slow-moving, non-moving, dead, obsolete, damaged, and excess stock. Prepare stock ageing, inventory movement, reconciliation, and variance reports for management. Coordinate with Purchase, Production, Sales, Dispatch, and Finance on inventory operations. Work with Finance to monitor inventory value, dead and excess stock, and working-capital impact. Maintain item codes, product specifications, stock locations, delivery points, and inventory master data. Utilize inventory controls to minimize discrepancies, excess inventory, dead stock, and stock-outs. Required Qualifications and Skills Strong attention to detail, numerical ability, and record-keeping skills. Good coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently and maintain accurate inventory records. Experience in manufacturing, engineering, rubber products, conveyor belts, or trading is advantageous. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

bb931f170d8a3856.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فطيرة الفلافل للمطاعم عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية الإدارة المالية والتخطيط داخل المؤسسة، مع التركيز على إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يشمل الدور تحليل السيولة وأسعار الفائدة والعملات والمخاطر المرتبطة بها لضمان الاستقرار المالي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناتجة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات شروط التمويل لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة التخطيط المالي وتحليل التدفقات النقدية. فهم جيد لمبادئ إدارة السيولة والتمويل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل أمين الصندوق ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. عن شركة فطيرة الفلافل للمطاعم تلتزم شركة فطيرة الفلافل للمطاعم بتقديم تجربة مميزة لعملائها، وتسعى لتعزيز فريقها بكفاءات تسهم في تحقيق أهدافها المالية والتشغيلية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

bbddda5c3b8ab800.description: About the Role Juffali Commercial Vehicles is seeking a Production Foreman to join their team in Makkah, specifically within King Abdullah Economic City. This full-time role involves overseeing production activities and ensuring operational efficiency within assigned areas. The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Oversee and coordinate the activities of Production Group Leaders and assembly workers across assigned production areas. Execute the approved daily production plan in coordination with the Production Planning Engineer, ensuring shop floor activities align with production priorities and sequence. Allocate and balance manpower based on the daily production plan, workload, skills, absences, and operational priorities. Monitor hourly and daily production progress, identify deviations from targets, and take immediate operational action or escalate issues as required. Ensure assembly work is performed according to approved assembly documentation, standard work, quality requirements, and required production records. Coordinate closely with Quality, Logistics/Stores, Maintenance, and other supporting functions regarding material shortages, quality concerns, equipment issues, and other constraints affecting production. Monitor line-side material availability and coordinate shortages with Logistics/Stores to prevent production delays. Conduct daily/start-of-shift briefings with Group Leaders covering production targets, priorities, safety, quality issues, and special instructions. Ensure production documentation, checklists, and traceability requirements are completed correctly and on time. Enforce health and safety requirements, conduct regular safety briefings, and immediately address or escalate unsafe conditions and practices. Identify recurring production and quality issues, support root-cause analysis and corrective actions, and follow up on the implementation of approved improvements. Coach and develop Group Leaders and production personnel to improve performance, discipline, technical capability, and teamwork. Maintain effective communication with the Head of Production & Logistics and provide timely status updates on production performance, manpower, constraints, and major issues. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a production supervision or foreman role. Demonstrated ability to coordinate and oversee production activities effectively. Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, and safety protocols. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah. The role requires active involvement on the production floor and close collaboration with various functional teams to maintain operational flow and address challenges. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

bbdf71110a2eb526.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Lead Field Services Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves performing services and maintenance activities on customer sites, primarily focusing on electrical rotating machines such as synchronous and induction motors and generators, and excitation systems. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in related field services engineering. Role Context and Scope The Lead Field Services Engineer is responsible for contributing to, maintaining, repairing, and refurbishing sold or existing GEV Power Conversion & Storage products. This includes all types of maintenance services, such as preventive and remedial, and managing maintenance facilities. The role operates within a well-defined operational framework, following a step-by-step sequence of standard operational tasks to achieve desired results. Accountability for the quality of work performed is a key aspect of this position. Key Responsibilities Perform on-site installation, commissioning, refurbishment, startup, maintenance, troubleshooting, and upgrading of synchronous and induction machines, as well as excitation and AVR systems. Respond to requests for emergency repairs and services promptly. Provide technical instruction and assistance to customer representatives regarding installation, operation, calibration, repair, and maintenance at customer sites. Prepare comprehensive and timely technical reports, including job status reports, reports to customers, time sheets, and expense sheets. Order necessary materials and secure quotations for services and repairs. Provide leadership and technical direction to skilled labor performing work on customer sites. Maintain a strong safety mindset, ensuring all executed work adheres to technical requirements and GE safety standards. Prepare timely and accurate technical reports for customer records and as a reference for future outages. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in field services engineering, specifically with electrical rotating machines and excitation systems. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern region, requiring travel to customer sites to perform service and maintenance activities. The role involves direct operational supervision and adherence to prescribed work instructions and systems checking.

bbe175b00af0c179.description: About Unifonic Unifonic is an AI-native customer experience platform with over 25 years of conversational AI research and development. The company serves more than 5,000 enterprises across MENA, focusing on sovereign, agentic AI through its Agentic Studio platform. Unifonic is recognized as a Great Place to Work®. The Engineering Team The Engineering team at Unifonic is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of the systems and technologies that power Unifonic’s solutions. This team collaborates with other departments to ensure products and services meet customer needs. Candidates passionate about technology and communication solutions are encouraged to apply. Role Overview: Arabic Linguist – AI & TTS Unifonic is seeking an Arabic Linguist to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh Province. This part-time role supports the Text-to-Speech (TTS) team by providing linguistic analysis, Arabic dialect expertise, pronunciation and speech-quality evaluation, and assistance with voice-related projects. The position involves contributing linguistic expertise to production projects and enhancing the quality, accuracy, and naturalness of Arabic speech technology. Key Responsibilities Conduct research on the phonological, morphological, and syntactic structures of Arabic, with a focus on Modern Standard Arabic (MSA) and Saudi/Gulf dialects, particularly the Najdi dialect. Provide linguistic guidance for the integration of Arabic linguistic structures into Sestek products. Act as a linguistic point of contact for the R&D / AI team. Translate linguistic requirements into clear, actionable input for engineers. Analyze and review pronunciation data, including grapheme-to-phoneme mappings, diacritization/tashkeel, and lexicons, for Arabic TTS and speech recognition systems. Evaluate TTS output quality in terms of pronunciation accuracy, prosody, dialect authenticity, and naturalness, with a particular focus on Saudi Arabic. Provide linguistic guidance and support for Arabic voice data collection and speech synthesis projects. Identify and onboard suitable voice talents when needed. Support the coordination and review of voice recording and editing processes to ensure linguistic accuracy and consistency. Support the onboarding and coordination of external Arabic language consultants when needed, providing guidance on linguistic requirements. Role Overview The Ops L Subject Matter Expert (SME) will serve as a specialist resource, bridging the Global Support team and in-country White Glove resources. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, requires deep operational, language, and local-market expertise to address complex cases and escalations. The SME will also be responsible for continuous knowledge transfer to the broader support organization, aiming to enhance the team's independent problem-solving capabilities. Key Responsibilities Act as the subject matter expert for complex operational cases and escalations. Support L1 and White Glove teams with issues requiring deeper operational or local-market expertise. Coordinate with Network, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve issues. Provide clear operational guidance during high-impact customer escalations. Develop knowledge of Saudi payment methods, partners, operating practices, and customer requirements. Provide Arabic and English language support as needed. Bring local context to issues not effectively managed through standard global processes. Translate market-specific knowledge into practical guidance for the wider support organization. Work with in-country White Glove resources supporting strategic customers, providing specialist operational expertise. Support complex investigations and escalations without becoming the primary processor of standard customer inquiries. Identify and address recurring reasons for customer contact. Convert complex cases and lessons learned into SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and reusable knowledge. Coach and upskill the Global Support team on recurring issues. Identify cases that can be progressively shifted back to L1 through improved knowledge, processes, or tooling. Ensure market knowledge is institutionalized rather than dependent on individual employees. Analyze recurring escalations and identify underlying operational gaps. Recommend improvements across processes, tooling, automation, and customer education. Work with relevant teams to address root causes. bb118f5d4ec280f6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خياري الامثل للمقاولات عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء لضمان الأداء الأمثل والمطابقة للمواصفات الفنية ومعايير السلامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية عملها بكفاءة. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف. التأكد من دقة أداء الأنظمة ومطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية ومعايير الجودة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم جيد لمكونات أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف ومبادئ عملها. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتطبيقها في العمل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تواصل فعالة. بيئة العمل يقع هذا الدور في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة خياري الامثل للمقاولات. يتطلب الدور العمل الميداني لتركيب وصيانة الأنظمة في مواقع مختلفة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذا الدور.

bb7d7cc05736c843.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمدادات المتقدمة لخدمات الاعاشة عن مدير مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى مدير المبيعات مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط وتنظيم أعمال المبيعات للسلع والخدمات، بما يضمن التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة للشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الأهداف الرئيسية والخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية للمبيعات، وضمان تطبيقها بنجاح والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. الإشراف على كافة الأعمال والأنشطة اليومية للمبيعات، بما في ذلك ضبط أسعار البيع ومراقبة حركة المبيعات ومستوياتها لمختلف المنتجات والخدمات مقارنة بالخطط والتوقعات المالية. ضمان التنسيق والتواصل الفعال مع شركاء العمل، وبناء قاعدة واسعة من العملاء، والتواصل المستمر معهم للتعرف على ملاحظاتهم حول أساليب البيع والأسعار والعروض المنافسة. تقديم التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة العليا بناءً على ملاحظات العملاء ودراسات السوق. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد التقارير والتحليلات الفنية لأنشطة المبيعات السابقة، ومراجعتها وعرضها على الإدارة العليا مع المقترحات والتوصيات الفنية. الإشراف على أداء موظفي المبيعات وتوجيههم نحو أفضل أساليب وممارسات البيع، وضمان فهمهم لمواصفات وخصائص المنتجات والخدمات. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق المبيعات، وضمان توافر جميع الموارد والمواد والتقنيات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال وأنشطة البيع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال المبيعات. فهم عميق لأساليب وممارسات البيع وتخطيط المبيعات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والتحليلات الفنية للمبيعات. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. طبيعة الدور يتضمن الدور متابعة كافة العمليات والخدمات المقدمة في مجالات إدارة وتخطيط المبيعات، ودراسة وتحديد أساليب وأماكن البيع، بالإضافة إلى إعداد تقارير المبيعات ومستوياتها بشكل دوري. التقديم نرحب بالمرشحين الذين يمتلكون الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة في شركة إمدادات المتقدمة لخدمات الاعاشة.

bb3804dd3f1c27b8.description: We’re on the hunt for a Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist with the curiosity of a detective, the calm of a bomb disposal expert, and the analytical instincts of someone who enjoys untangling the world’s messiest PowerShell scripts. You’ll be joining the NetWitness Incident Response team in Saudi Arabia, working alongside a group of battle-tested DFIR professionals who thrive on turning chaos into clarity. You’ll investigate security incidents, perform digital forensics, analyze malware, and help organizations recover from the kind of problems that usually start with, "We just saw some unusual network traffic..." If you enjoy pulling threads to find out what really happened, and you’ve ever taken apart malware “just to see what makes it tick,” you’ll fit right in. Key Responsibilities Conduct cyber incident investigations and digital forensic analysis (sans drama, but with precision). Perform malware triage, memory forensics, and compromise assessments. Document findings clearly enough that even your non-technical colleagues will think you’re a wizard. Work with global NetWitness IR experts to respond to complex attacks and improve detection. Share knowledge, challenge hypotheses, and occasionally utter phrases like “It depends” with confidence. At least 5 years of solid, hands-on experience in cybersecurity. Minimum 2 years of direct involvement in incident response, digital forensics, or malware analysis. Alternatively, visible public research or open-source projects in DFIR or malware analysis are perfectly acceptable — we value results over titles. Strong technical foundation in Windows, Linux, and network investigations. Comfortable using tools like NetWitness, Volatility, Velociraptor, or your own custom scripts. Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash – bonus points if you’ve written something that made your teammates both grateful and slightly afraid. SANS certifications (GCFA, GREM, GNFA, GCFE, etc.) are definite pluses, as is a calm demeanor during incidents that make others panic. Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is a welcome advantage. Work with some of the brightest minds in digital forensics and incident response. Get hands-on with major cybersecurity incidents while using serious tooling (and a healthy dose of wit). Be part of a team that values curiosity, professional rigor, and the occasional well-timed sarcastic observation. Continual learning and growth opportunities through global collaboration and SANS-aligned training. If this sounds like your sort of challenge — and you’ve been known to say “I’ll just have a quick look at that memory dump” moments before losing three hours — we’d quite like to hear from you.
